study.question: Which value coordinates must remain bound to a same-event target-field conjunction: its two defining item fields, or the other four item fields plus historical action? Observed limitation: pair_joint_both reaches validation macro AUC 0.8314095191 vs 0.8305072495 for pair_joint_counts (same joint counts, marginal content), a +0.0009022696 difference. Joint content with marginal counts reaches 0.8313959542. This does not distinguish weighted target-copy intensity from cross-field/event associations. For any shared embedding weights, the defining joint coordinates equal the matching target embedding times a signed activation mass, up to floating-point accumulation. Encoded equality does not establish real-world entity identity.
study.hypothesis: The conditional content gain is carried substantially by binding the other item fields and historical action to the joint match, rather than only by copying the two matched target-field embeddings under a learned scalar activation mass. Replacing defining-coordinate joint content with its marginal estimate while retaining other-coordinate joint content may preserve quality or reduce redundant conditioning. This is an untested local representation hypothesis, with no priority claim. The closest factorial already controls counts; the proposed partition adds no trainable capacity.

nearest_work.difference: Direct local parent: keep its 15 same-event pair summaries and all projections; replace source selection independently on defining versus other value coordinates. The full-joint and full-marginal corners reproduce the prior joint-content and marginal-content/joint-count cells.

Archived v4 primary text lines 271-277 explicitly motivates unnormalized activation mass. Inherit signed target-aware pooling, but test which coordinates carry a joint-versus-marginal conjunction gain; this is not a new claim about unnormalized attention.

Pinned benchmark forward/tokenizer lines 113-159 pools history before field/task tokenization. Our inherited compact token block is retained; only the coordinate source of pair-conditioned summaries changes. No reproduction or original-paper equivalence is asserted.
Pinned forward lines 123-169 forms feedback-masked hubs and iterates exchanges. Inherit the local one-way feedback memory equally across cells; do not add INFNet hub broadcasts or task queries.

Pinned tokenizer lines 161-211 maps full events and target through MLPs into mixed tokens. Our candidate retains compressed relation summaries and tests coordinate-level binding without an event-token attention backbone.
Only the author README was available, including its category/brand/behavior field warning; full publisher text remains unavailable. No full-method or novelty comparison is established.

study.proposed_difference: For each pair (r,s), form a fixed boolean coordinate mask D_rs over the concatenated six item embeddings plus action: exactly the r and s item blocks are true (32 of 112 coordinates at embedding_dim=16); the remaining four item blocks and action are false (80 coordinates). Let J_rs=sum_i[m_r(i)m_s(i)w_i v_i]/sqrt(7) and F_rs=(n_s S_r+n_r S_s)/(2n), with S_r=sum_i[m_r(i)w_i v_i]/sqrt(7) and counts unweighted within each temporal bin; n is clamped to at least one only for division. Feed where(D_rs, chosen_defining_source, chosen_other_source) to the existing pair bank together with the unchanged joint log-count. Each source is independently J or F. No values are zeroed, no new token/key/parameter is introduced, and masks and both summary kernels remain identical. All four cells use the same torch.where operation; all-joint and all-marginal corners copy the exact parent source tensors without subtraction/readdition. Fixed selector construction uses no random draws.
predictions: Primary: both conditional effects of other-coordinate joint binding are positive: AUC(other_joint)-AUC(full_marginal) and AUC(full_joint)-AUC(defining_joint). Defining-only should explain less of the prior content gain. A hybrid need not beat full_joint to provide useful attribution.

Evaluate interaction I=AUC(full_joint)-AUC(defining_joint)-AUC(other_joint)+AUC(full_marginal); do not assume additive or independent effects. Use the same contrasts for macro Logloss and each task. Select any candidate only by the frozen four-task macro AUC and tie breakers.

Replay predictions, initialization/state and trained metrics should match g0-r0013-pair_joint_both and g0-r0013-pair_joint_counts within host numerical reproducibility. A mismatch is an implementation/measurement issue, not a scientific effect.

Report all four task AUC/Logloss deltas versus incumbent and baseline. Prior parent-vs-marginal content AUC deltas are click +0.0001620095, cart +0.0009321410, fav +0.0013469960, buy +0.0011679318; Logloss deltas are +0.0000114697, -0.0000269972, -0.0000535822, -0.0000890481. Thus the prior macro gain includes a small click calibration regression.

Existing history bins 0, 1-16, 17-64, >64 remain exploratory diagnostics. Parent/marginal macro AUCs are respectively 0.7222106/0.7241014, 0.7799985/0.7793012, 0.8081177/0.8068169, 0.8539898/0.8533976. Empty-history differences after training can reflect shared parameter changes; they are not evidence of information in an empty history. Report supplied sample/positive/negative counts; do not invent unavailable frequency/hour or pair-occupancy slices.

Implementation checks completed before submission: study schema and evidence IDs valid; all six historical industry-card assessments covered; baseline and parent source digests verified; four modules compile; CONFIG values match constructor defaults and complete factorial; normalized source is identical across cells; 18 inherited methods and parameter/module initialization-call ASTs match the parent; independent scalar oracle passes 200 cases / 15,000 pair-bin comparisons. This is reproducible source/algebra evidence, not executed tensor, learning or mechanism evidence. Actual PyTorch execution is unavailable here and must pass host checks before interpreting results.
falsifiers: If defining_joint matches full_joint while other_joint matches full_marginal across paired repetitions, the proposed other-field binding explanation is unsupported; learned joint intensity/target repetition is a better provisional explanation.
If neither conditional other-coordinate effect is stable, or gains reverse across paired seeds/tasks, do not claim mechanism support from the prior single-seed gain.
A large interaction supports coupled use of both coordinate groups, not the proposed sufficiency of the other group. One failed hybrid does not refute every event-binding mechanism.

Host nonfinite values, masked-ID/task-mask perturbation dependence, current-action dependence, replay failure or unexpected parameter/initialization differences invalidate the affected comparison and consume charged budget.
A capacity/optimization explanation remains possible even with matched parameter tensors. No novelty or external transfer claim follows from these local comparisons.
alternative_explanations: Unnormalized signed activation mass multiplying known target embeddings may explain much of the content gain; DIN already motivates such intensity.
Marginal-source replacement changes feature distributions and effective rank, so optimization/regularization rather than additional information may dominate.
Item/campaign/customer/category dependencies may make many pair intersections redundant; no actual nesting frequency is assumed without authorized measurements.

Prior negative/null branches: feedback-count additions in round 4 underperformed zero replay; timing decomposition did not isolate a winner over duplicate full; bound feedback content in round 10 underperformed factorized; separate feedback memory did not win round 11; all four event/pooled nonlinear/linear variants in round 12 failed to exceed the 0.8303789179 incumbent. These are implementation-specific observations, not general mechanism refutations.
All supplied trials succeeded operationally and previous_runtime_error is null; statistical uncertainty and abandoned directions must not be relabeled runtime failures.

cost_plan.attribution_reserve: All four cells, replay checks, failed diagnostics/retries and host overhead are charged. Do not override the frozen seed through architecture configs. cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve a further 1,950s at 650s/unit for a frozen validation-only comparison suite if required and affordable, avoiding duplicate scoring when existing receipts suffice. Total planned 8,450s leaves about 4,743s for preparation/uncertainty at the supplied budget snapshot; host must recheck actual ledger. No test/holdout access is requested or used. Training and tensor checks run only through the host after this proposal phase.
cost_plan.stop_rule: No local training or installations. Before host execution require finite forward/backward, empty/masked histories, excluded target action, overlapping historical masks, parameter/init and replay checks. Stop on the hard ledger/deadline or when a complete useful admissible unit plus required reserves will not fit. Preserve failures and unknown execution states; do not silently retry, change the frozen recipe, or infer approval for duplicate assessment. Selection remains validation macro AUC; new outcomes are unknown at submission.
